svg.desc: Original keywords: brainstorming,business,businessmen,businesswomen,ideas,inspirations,light bulbs,metaphors,people,teamwork. This clipart was ripped from the Microsoft website, then uploaded to https://archive.org/details/MS_Clipart_Collection. (The original WMF file can be found within that item, under the folder MC900389014). From there, it was then converted by Trumad to svg using https://github.com/hidekatsu-izuno/wmf2svg in a bulk operation. All the converted files can be found at https://archive.org/details/MS_Clipart_Collection_SVG
